       COUNTIF(LOWER(status) = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_orders,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(LOWER(status) = 'cancelled'), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS cancelled_pct,
       status
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.orders`
WHERE order_date IN ('2026-10-01',
                     '2026-10-02')
GROUP BY status
UNION ALL
